embed.title: !raid
embed.description: Alerts for hatched raid bosses at gyms. Track by boss, by raid level, or every level. For eggs before they hatch, see `{{prefix}}help egg`.

fields.name: By boss
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}raid tyranitar`
`{{prefix}}raid tyranitar metagross salamence d:1000` — any of these, within 1 km
`{{prefix}}raid giratina form:origin_forme` — one form (`{{prefix}}info giratina forms`)
`{{prefix}}raid pikachu costume:holiday` — one costume; `costume:0` means no costume

fields.name: By level
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}raid level:5` — all level 5 raids
`{{prefix}}raid level:1-3` — a range of levels
`{{prefix}}raid everything` — every level
Level names: `legendary` (5), `mega` (6), `mega_legendary` (7), `ultra_beast` (8), `elite` (9), `primal` (10), `shadow` (11-15), `shadow_legendary` (15)

Use one level name per command; for more, use separate commands or a pipe: `{{prefix}}raid legendary | mega`

fields.name: Filters
fields.value:
`valor` / `mystic` / `instinct` / `harmony` (or `red` / `blue` / `yellow` / `gray`) — team holding the gym
`ex` — EX-eligible gyms only
`move:meteor_mash` — only bosses with this move
`"gym:Town Hall"` — one gym by name or id (quote names with spaces)

Example: `{{prefix}}raid level:5 valor d:1500`

fields.name: RSVP updates
fields.value:
By default you get one alert per raid.
`rsvp` — also alert again when its RSVP counts change
`rsvp_only` — only alert when the raid has RSVPs
`no_rsvp` — the default (one alert, no RSVP updates)

fields.name: Where
fields.value:
`d:1500` — within 1500 m of your location
`d:500 location:home` — measure from a saved location (`{{prefix}}help location`)
`area:city_centre` — only in these areas instead of your `{{prefix}}area` list

fields.name: Message options
Remove and mute
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}raid remove tyranitar`
`{{prefix}}raid remove level:5` (or `remove legendary`)
`{{prefix}}raid remove everything`
`{{prefix}}raid remove id:12` — one rule by the id shown in `{{prefix}}tracked`
`{{prefix}}raid mute id:12 duration:2h` — pause one rule without deleting it (`{{prefix}}help mute`)
